description: This file contains source code for Torch Inductor's intermediate representation (IR) nodes and related utilities, used for defining and manipulating IR nodes such as pointwise operations, reductions, loops, and other computational graph components within the compiler backend.

classes.name: Scan
classes.description: Represents a scanning operation over tensors with reindexing and reduction capabilities, supporting various inner functions and flexible view manipulations.

classes.name: SplitScan
classes.description: A specialized scan operation supporting Triton split kernel code generation on CUDA.

classes.name: Sort
classes.description: Represents sorting operations on a tuple of key-value pairs, supporting stable, ascending/descending sorts, and different layout considerations.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Base class that holds tensor meta-information including size, stride, offset, device, and methods to determine contiguity and stride ordering.

classes.name: OutputSpec
classes.description: Abstract class representing the memory layout of op outputs.

classes.name: ReinterpretView
classes.description: A view that pretends the underlying storage has a different layout, enabling reinterpretation without data copying.

classes.name: DtypeView
classes.description: A view that pretends the storage has a different data type, enabling dtype reinterpretation.

classes.name: BaseView
classes.description: Base class for views that modify how the underlying storage is interpreted, supporting reindexing, layout adjustments, and shape transformations.

classes.name: PermuteView
classes.description: A view that permutes tensor dimensions according to specified dims, supporting flexible reordering.

classes.name: ExpandView
classes.description: A view that expands tensor dimensions, broadcasting sizes as needed.

classes.name: SqueezeView
classes.description: A view that removes singleton dimensions; supports normalize size and dynamic reindexing.

classes.name: GenericView
classes.description: A flexible view class that supports custom reindexing functions and size transformations.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a tensor constant with a specific dtype and device, with methods for making loaders and device transfer.

classes.name: IndexingConstant
classes.description: A constant representing an index expression, used for index-based constants.
